show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/f2hyey
show.description: A wealthy businessman, Abhilash Singhania, loses his memory after nearly drowning while saving his son. Presumed dead, he starts a new life as a humble hotel worker, unknowingly serving his own family years later. Raised by him, an orphan girl Shikha becomes his emotional anchor. Meanwhile, his son Vihaan—now the hotel owner—mistreats him under manipulation and misunderstanding. As fragments of memory resurface and family paths cross, the story builds toward an emotional reunion.
